title: Secure Enclave Hardware Key Ladder & Cryptographic Engine Specification

key_ladder.architecture: Hardware-enforced derivation hierarchy with zero-software-exposure root registers

UID0.name: Die Unique ID
UID0.exposure: Write-only internal bus to AES engine. Inaccessible to software.
UID0.role: Silicon identity binding; ensures filesystem decryption only succeeds on the exact originating chip.

GID0.name: Group ID
GID0.exposure: Write-only internal bus to AES engine. Inaccessible to software.
GID0.role: Family-level trust assertion and production firmware envelope decryption.

hierarchy_levels.name: Silicon Root
hierarchy_levels.hardware_gate: Hardwired to cryptographic core; zero software bus access.

hierarchy_levels.name: Device Key Encryption Key (Device KEK)
hierarchy_levels.role: Root key for encrypting file system keybags and device identity tokens.

hierarchy_levels.name: Class Protection Keys (Class A through D)
hierarchy_levels.role: Per-class volume and file encryption keys.

hierarchy_levels.name: Hardware-Enforced Passcode Iteration
hierarchy_levels.algorithm: scrypt / PBKDF2 with silicon backoff delays
hierarchy_levels.derivation: scrypt(Passcode, Salt, N=32768, r=8, p=1) bound to UID0
hierarchy_levels.role: Prevents offline brute-force attacks against user passcodes.

cipher_modes: AES-256-XTS (APFS storage encryption and Memory Encryption Engine MEE)
AES-256-GCM (Authenticated message encapsulation and backup bag encryption)
AES-256-CBC (Legacy storage compatibility and biometric templates)
aes_engine.key_registers: Write-only internal registers loaded via hardware key ladder or TRNG. Inaccessible to AP, SPTM, or sepOS.

direct_hardware_bindings.role: Direct APFS media key unwrapping via hardware UID ladder.
Data Protection Class Key derivation bound to user passcode and hardware UID.
Real-time, low-latency AES-XTS encryption of all data written to external Secure DRAM carveouts.

supported_curves_and_algorithms: RSA 2048 / 4096-bit modular exponentiation and PKCS#1 / PSS verification
hardware_countermeasures: Constant-time point multiplication and modular inversion immune to timing side-channels
Hardware register blinding and power analysis countermeasures
use_cases: Pearl Face ID: Biometric match token signature and attestation
Apple Pay: EMV dynamic data authentication (DDA) cryptogram signing
FIDO2 / WebAuthn: Passkey generation and challenge signing
Secure Boot: Image4 manifest certificate validation
